question: Can a fixed numerical equation-memory learner acquire useful transition models from arbitrary trajectory observations without requiring zero/basis/subcube probes?
hypothesis: Bit-parallel gated GF2 elimination plus explicit observed-fact numeric memory can infer labels whose feature vectors lie in the observation span, preserving facts and uncertainty. A fixed hierarchy of degree1/2/3/full polynomial feature banks can reject inconsistent lower priors from actual contradictions. Shared trajectory evidence isolates the learning-rule difference from WSP46's subcube certificate bottleneck.
world: Frozen WSP46 source generator, disjoint world tags. Exact same least-visit source policy and raw action/reset budgets for every learning arm. Generate one genuine trajectory per world, stream identical ordered actual replies into every candidate/control. No arbitrary-state injection or hidden source/reachability data supplied.
numeric_algorithm: Each bank preallocates one pivot row per monomial feature. For every observation, fixed column loop uses row-bit AND occupancy gates for XOR elimination, and row-bit AND unoccupied gates for one-hot masked numeric pivot/rhs writes. Stored rows/rhs/occupancy are numeric bit registers; no host candidate search or dictionary learning. Prediction eliminates query features with the same fixed stored rows; residual zero plus nonfault signals model-relative known. A numeric observed-address bitplane memory overrides with actual observed facts. Word-wise Boolean operations are a bit-parallel implementation of supplied fixed gated circuit; generic Python simulator remains.
adaptive: Maintain all4 banks (degree1,2,3,full), choose first nonfaulted bank by fixed numeric first-viable winner gates, never family/world-ID selection. Model validity is relative to selected finite prior; a consistent wrong prior can be confident before a contradiction. Always report that limitation.
capacity: Per action/bank M pivot feature words of M bits, M width-bit rhs words, M occupancy bits, and full observed fact bitplanes/seen. M=sum(C(width,k),k<=degree). All4 banks preallocated; larger/multiple bank capacity is explicit, not matched to WSP46. Same exact evidence/action cost, measure actual CPU/memory.
arms: independent batch sparse-set GF2 system identifier on identical facts/features, with observed-fact override
frozen WSP46 numeric subcube learner on same exact trajectory
fully fitted one-hot least-squares observed-fact control

tests.reachable_unseen: 64 common genuinely unseen reachable queries if available; otherwise report unavailable and exhaustive reachable replay separately
tests.full_replay: all state/action pairs, distinguish observed and unreachable
tests.knowledge: validity/abstentions counted wrong in accuracy; report known coverage and correctness separately
tests.cold: canonical snapshots/digest tamper rejection/replay of every bank; no source calls during reconstruction
tests.retention: later updates on other action do not mutate first action; all observed facts remain exact after later data
tests.counterworld: an unobserved edge can change while preserving all actual source replies; inference is prior-relative, not proof of arbitrary unknown facts

trained_control: Converged independent GF2 algebraic system-ID on the same candidate vocabulary/data is the strongest matched mathematical control and must tie. One-hot conventional least-squares head also fits supplied labels exactly. These are not strongest matched neural models and cannot establish neural-training replacement.

thresholds.engineering: complete mandatory original+prior regression,focused new tests,clean tree/G29 Windows/Linux; identical integer scores/trace; numerical/batch fit prediction+validity parity
thresholds.equation: zero wrong known predictions for each source family's matching degree bank (linear1,quadratic2,cubic3,hash full) and exact observed-fact recall for every bank; no confidence guarantee for misspecified priors
thresholds.bounded: adaptive on all structured linear/quadratic/cubic worlds at1024 steps>=95% genuinely unseen reachable accuracy when evaluable,>=90% reachable replay,and100% observed recall; frozen WSP46 common-data comparison reported without filtering; lack of unseen cases explicit
thresholds.science: DEV_SUPPORTED only if bounds/invariants pass, MIXED otherwise, INVALID on matched-prior known-prediction or numeric/reference parity violation. No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS,unknown representation/primitive invention,GI or general efficiency/training superiority.

authority: External bounded public synthetic contributor draft only; no main/merge/accepted refs,official loop,private runner,protected first-use,controller,scheduler,paid API,integration,deployment or live action.
limits: Fixed polynomial vocabulary and Gaussian elimination circuit are supplied, not discovered.
Adaptive uses a preprogrammed finite model hierarchy, not arbitrary new operations.
All observed-fact memory and larger equation-bank capacity count.
No proof that consistent low-degree prior is the true source family; outside-prior confident negatives must remain.
negative_scope: Before implementation, clarify that arbitrary-hash unseen labels are an information-theoretic negative and excluded from positive structured-transfer threshold, while all hash cases remain scored/reported. No PRIMARY/DEV result informed this clarification.
